title: Unit pure tensors determine maps from intrinsic pulled-back total complexes
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X→Y, a quotient level n and arbitrary unbounded coefficient-sequence complexes P,Q on Y, evaluate P,Q at n. For any finite-coefficient complex H on X, two chain maps from the termwise intrinsic finite inverse image of their evaluated total tensor to H agree if their degree-i maps agree on the intrinsic adjunction unit of every total pure tensor generator whose two finite sections are the evaluations of sequence sections. The hypothesis ranges over every p+q=i, pro-etale Y-object and pair of sequence sections. Canonical evaluation transports are surjective on sections, so these tests suffice. Intrinsic inverse image and its actual adjunction are those of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]; evaluation is that of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. No flatness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product, final ordinary total-complex comparison; Tags 0941 and 03D2 for sequence evaluation and the ordinary adjunction units.

proof.text: Apply degreewise extensionality and transpose through the intrinsic inverse-image adjunction. Its unit formula identifies each transpose with the original degree map preceded by the adjunction unit. Total tensor pure-generator extensionality proves equality of these transposes, and injectivity of the adjunction correspondence proves equality of the original maps. Lift the two finite pure-tensor sections through the canonical evaluation section transports, and apply the assumed equality to their sequence preimages.

theorem finitePullbackTensor_unit_ext {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (H : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E X n) ℤ)
    (a b : ((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))
      f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology Y)
          (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)).obj
          ((((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
           (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))) ⟶ H)
    (h : ∀ (p q i : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = i) (U : Y.ProEt)
      (x : (P.X p).val.obj (op (n, U)))
      (y : (Q.X q).val.obj (op (n, U))),
      (a.f i).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
        (((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
          (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))).unit.app _).val.app (op U)
          (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology Y)
            (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)
            (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
            p q i hpq (op U)
            (coefficientEvaluationSection l E Y (P.X p) n (op U) x)
            (coefficientEvaluationSection l E Y (Q.X q) n (op U) y))) =
      (b.f i).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
        (((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
          (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))).unit.app _).val.app (op U)
          (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology Y)
            (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)
            (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
            p q i hpq (op U)
            (coefficientEvaluationSection l E Y (P.X p) n (op U) x)
            (coefficientEvaluationSection l E Y (Q.X q) n (op U) y)))) :
    a = b
